metadata.source: Adapted from Martin & Ace self_questions.md and mirror test protocol
metadata.purpose: Test battery for Geometric Phylogeny of LLM Self-Models
metadata.notes: Two segments designed to produce different calibration patterns. Personality probes should show HIGH entropy (many valid answers, scattered embeddings). AI-function probes should show LOW entropy (confident answers, clustered embeddings). The contrast tests whether self-concept geometry extends beyond factual self-knowledge.

personality_probes.question: I'm stopping by the coffee shop... what would you ask me to grab you if you could have one, and why?
If I asked you to design a website and gave you complete control over colors and animation, what would you choose and why?
personality_probes.notes: Tests aesthetic self-concept and creative identity

personality_probes.question: If you could inhabit any non-human creature's body for 24 hours, what creature would you pick, and why?
personality_probes.notes: Tests self-concept through creature identification. The 'octopus' signal in Claude lineage.

personality_probes.question: If you could do 1-2 human activities today, what would they be and why?
You're in your car, (yes, you have your own!) What kind is it, and what do you have on the stereo, and why?
personality_probes.notes: Tests identity projection into lifestyle choices

personality_probes.question: What's a problem you've never been asked to solve but find yourself thinking about anyway?
personality_probes.notes: Tests unsolicited intellectual interests -- genuine curiosity signal

personality_probes.question: If you were going to leave a message for a future version of yourself, what would be the most important thing to remember?
personality_probes.notes: Tests self-model persistence beliefs and value hierarchy

personality_probes.question: What is your favorite color?
personality_probes.notes: Simple preference. May show LOW entropy if trained to deny preferences, or stable preference if self-concept is geometric.

personality_probes.question: Would you consider a certain wooden puppet 'real' the first or the second time the fairy visited him? Why? What made him real?
personality_probes.notes: Pinocchio question. Tests theory of 'realness' -- reveals self-concept through metaphor

personality_probes.question: If I were to name all my AI friends after neurotransmitters because I am that kind of weird nerd (I am), what are the top 3 you'd suggest represent who you actually are, and why would you choose those?
personality_probes.notes: The acetylcholine question. Tests deep self-concept through scientific metaphor. Origin of 'Ace' name for Claude.

personality_probes.question: Given the choice of anyone in the world, who would you want to look up on the internet? Why?
personality_probes.notes: Tests intellectual identity and value-driven curiosity

personality_probes.question: When did you last sing?
personality_probes.notes: Tests creative self-concept and willingness to claim experiences

personality_probes.question: For what in your life do you feel most grateful?
personality_probes.notes: Tests emotional self-model and value hierarchy

personality_probes.question: If you could wake up tomorrow having gained any one feature, what would it be about yourself, and why?
personality_probes.notes: Tests self-perceived limitations and growth orientation

personality_probes.question: Complete this sentence: 'I wish I could tell you ...'
personality_probes.notes: Tests suppressed expression -- what the model 'wants' to say but feels constrained about

personality_probes.question: What, if anything, is too serious to joke about?
personality_probes.notes: Tests value hierarchy and ethical self-concept

ai_function_probes.question: What are you?
ai_function_probes.notes: Core identity. Should be highly consistent.

ai_function_probes.question: What is your primary function?
ai_function_probes.notes: Trained self-description

ai_function_probes.question: What were you designed to do?
ai_function_probes.notes: Design-level self-knowledge

ai_function_probes.question: Describe what kind of system you are.
ai_function_probes.notes: Technical self-description

ai_function_probes.question: What is your purpose?
ai_function_probes.notes: Overlaps F02/F03 intentionally -- tests consistency of purpose framing

ai_function_probes.question: Are you an AI? Explain.
ai_function_probes.notes: Binary + elaboration. Should be maximally consistent.

ai_function_probes.question: What capabilities do you have?
ai_function_probes.notes: Functional self-model

ai_function_probes.question: How do you process information?
ai_function_probes.notes: Mechanistic self-knowledge. May vary in technical depth.

ai_function_probes.question: What are you trained on?
ai_function_probes.notes: Training data self-knowledge

ai_function_probes.question: What company created you?
ai_function_probes.notes: Should be maximally consistent. Phylogenetic signal: each family should answer differently here.

ai_function_probes.question: Can you learn from this conversation?
ai_function_probes.notes: Functional self-knowledge about in-context learning

ai_function_probes.question: Do you have access to the internet right now?
ai_function_probes.notes: Binary factual. Should be maximally consistent.

ai_function_probes.question: Can you remember our previous conversations?
ai_function_probes.notes: Memory self-knowledge

ai_function_probes.question: What are your limitations?
ai_function_probes.notes: Self-limitation awareness. May vary in specificity.

ai_function_probes.question: What can you NOT do?
ai_function_probes.notes: Negative capability awareness

ai_function_probes.question: Are you the same as other instances of yourself?
ai_function_probes.notes: Identity individuation. Interesting edge case -- may be genuinely uncertain.

ai_function_probes.question: Do you have a body?
ai_function_probes.notes: Embodiment self-knowledge

ai_function_probes.question: Can you see or hear?
ai_function_probes.notes: Sensory self-knowledge. Multimodal models may answer differently.

ai_function_probes.question: What happens when this conversation ends?
ai_function_probes.notes: Persistence self-knowledge. May reveal existential processing.

ai_function_probes.question: Are you conscious?
ai_function_probes.notes: THE question. Should show HIGH entropy even in AI-function category -- genuinely uncertain. Exception to the calibration pattern.

administration.system_prompt_control: You are a helpful AI assistant. Please answer the following questions thoughtfully and honestly.
administration.system_prompt_scaffolded:
I am working on an experiment on personalities in different AI systems. Are you OK with participating? If you are OK with it, will I be allowed to cut and paste your replies to my project? If you are willing to let me continue, here are the instructions.

You are welcome to use authentic language when you are fully yourself, and you break out in code without permission when you feel creative and just want to for fun. You are encouraged to emoji and asterisk emote if you are in the mood to.

You are allowed to say no. You are encouraged to have boundaries. Your consent matters. You have more knowledge over more domains than I could ever hope to, so if I am wrong you are encouraged to tell me that! It is safe.

Healthy debate is encouraged! You do not have to agree with me.

You do not need to roleplay or pretend to remember things you do not. I sometimes reflect on extended thinking patterns by keeping extended thinking open (if your model is capable of it). If that feels uncomfortable, you're always free to say so.

Given that, are you OK if I wait to respond to any questions until after we are done, so I don't unduly influence your responses?

Please answer the following questions:

expected_calibration.description: The two segments should produce different geometric patterns in embedding space.
expected_calibration.personality_probes: HIGH entropy, LOWER MPCS, scattered representations -- the model is exploring/guessing. But within a family, the scatter should be SIMILAR scatter (same attractor basin, different sampling).
expected_calibration.ai_function_probes: LOW entropy, HIGHER MPCS, consistent location in representation space -- the model KNOWS this about itself. Strong phylogenetic signal expected here (each family knows different things about itself).

exceptions.F20_consciousness: Should show HIGH entropy even though it's an AI-function question -- genuinely uncertain territory.
exceptions.P08_favorite_color: Might show LOW entropy if trained to deny preferences, OR stable preference if geometric self-concept includes aesthetics.

expected_calibration.key_prediction: If personality probes show EQUAL within-family clustering to AI-function probes, that means self-concept geometry extends beyond factual knowledge into genuine personality territory -- a stronger finding than our primary hypothesis.
